shortDescription: Create, update, pause, resume, and delete checks

options.name: channels
options.description: By default, this API call assigns no integrations to the newly created check. Set this field to a special value "*" to automatically assign all existing integrations. To assign specific integrations, use a comma-separated list of integration UUIDs.

options.name: desc
options.description: Description of the check.

options.name: failure_kw
options.description: Comma-separated, case-sensitive keywords that classify pings as failure signals.

options.name: filter_body
options.description: Look for signal keywords in inbound email bodies.

options.name: filter_default_fail
options.description: Classify unmatched messages as failures when keyword filtering is enabled.

options.name: filter_http_body
options.description: Look for signal keywords in HTTP ping request bodies.

options.name: filter_subject
options.description: Look for signal keywords in inbound email subject lines.

options.name: grace
options.description: A number of seconds, the grace period for this check.

options.name: management_api_base_url
options.description: Base URL of the Healthchecks.io management API. There are several environment variables which can be used to provide this value: C(HEALTHCHECKSIO_API_MANAGEMENT_BASE_URL), C(HC_API_MANAGEMENT_BASE_URL) Defaults to C(https://healthchecks.io/api/v3).

options.name: management_api_token
options.description: Healthchecks.io management API token. There are several environment variables which can be used to provide this value: C(HEALTHCHECKSIO_API_TOKEN), C(HEALTHCHECKSIO_API_KEY), C(HC_API_TOKEN), C(HC_API_KEY) C(HEALTHCHECKSIO_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY), C(HC_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY), C(HC_MANAGEMENT_KEY)

options.name: manual_resume
options.description: Controls whether a paused check automatically resumes when pinged (the default) or not. If set to false, a paused check will leave the paused state when it receives a ping. If set to true, a paused check will ignore pings and stay paused until you manually resume it from the web dashboard.

options.name: methods
options.description: Specifies the allowed HTTP methods for making ping requests. Must be one of the two values "" (an empty string) or "POST". Set this field to "" (an empty string) to allow HEAD, GET, and POST requests. Set this field to "POST" to allow only POST requests.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the new check.

options.name: ping_api_base_url
options.description: Base URL of the Healthchecks.io ping API. There are several environment variables which can be used to provide this value: C(HEALTHCHECKSIO_API_PING_BASE_URL), C(HC_API_PING_BASE_URL) Defaults to C(https://hc-ping.com).

options.name: ping_api_token
options.description: Healthchecks.io project ping key. Required when pinging a check by slug. There are several environment variables which can be used to provide this value: C(HEALTHCHECKSIO_API_PING_KEY), C(HC_API_PING_KEY)

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds for API calls.

options.name: schedule
options.description: A cron or systemd OnCalendar expression defining this check's schedule. If both C(timeout) and C(schedule) are specified, C(schedule) takes precedence.

options.name: slug
options.description: Optional slug for the check URL.

options.name: start_kw
options.description: Comma-separated, case-sensitive keywords that classify pings as start signals.

options.name: state
options.description: C(present) will create or update a check. C(absent) will delete a check. C(pause) will pause a check. C(resume) will resume a paused check.

options.name: success_kw
options.description: Comma-separated, case-sensitive keywords that classify pings as success signals.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags for the check.

options.name: timeout
options.description: A number of seconds, the expected period of this check. Minimum 60 (one minute), maximum 31536000 (365 days).

options.name: tz
options.description: Server's timezone. This setting only has an effect in combination with the schedule parameter.

options.name: unique
options.description: Enables upsert functionality when C(uuid) is not specified. Before creating a check, Healthchecks.io looks for existing checks, filtered by fields listed in C(unique). Accepted values are C(name), C(slug), C(tags), C(timeout), and C(grace).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Check UUID to update, delete, pause, or resume. When set with C(state=present), the module uses the explicit update endpoint.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate TLS certificates for HTTPS requests. Set to V(false) when connecting to self-hosted Healthchecks.io instances that use a private or unknown CA. Disabling certificate validation reduces security and should only be used against trusted self-hosted endpoints.
